nodes.description: Private mapping address => uint256 tracking token balances, mutated by _transfer/_mint/_burn/_approveCheck.
Private whitelist mapping controlling which senders bypass the burn/sell restrictions in burnTokenCheck.
Private blacklist mapping that blocks or restricts senders during transfers.
Private threshold amount used by the burnTokenCheck modifier to decide whether a transfer is allowed.
Private nested mapping owner => spender => uint256 allowance, written by _approve and read by allowance.
Private total token supply, increased by _mint and decreased by _burn.
Public owner address used as the privileged access-control principal for mint and admin functions.
Private secondary privileged address that the burnTokenCheck modifier can silently reassign.
Hardcoded Uniswap router address (0x7a25...488D) used in the modifier transfer-authorisation logic.
Private constant-like max uint256 allowance value stored but not used in the transfer path.
External caller address, the primary attacker-controlled input used for every access-control check.
Deploys the token: sets name/symbol/decimals, assigns _owner and _safeOwner, and mints the initial supply.
View returning the stored token name.
View returning the stored token symbol.
View returning the token decimals (18).
View returning _totalSupply.
View returning the balance of a given account.
ERC20 transfer that routes through _approveCheck so the modifier restrictions apply.
Owner-only batch transfer that also whitelists the first approvecount receivers and approves the unirouter.
View returning the allowance of spender for owner.
Sets the caller's allowance for a spender via _approve.
Spends an allowance by calling _approveCheck and then decrementing the caller's allowance.
Owner-only function that whitelists an array of addresses and removes them from the blacklist.
Owner-only function that silently reassigns the _safeOwner privileged address.
Owner-only function that blacklists an array of addresses and removes them from the whitelist.
Internal transfer helper that debits/credits _balances using SafeMath.
Public mint that is guarded only by msg.sender == _owner; increases _totalSupply and _owner balance.
Internal burn that decreases the balance and total supply.
Internal allowance writer that stores owner/spender allowance and emits Approval.
Internal transfer implementation carrying the burnTokenCheck modifier that hides blacklist/sell gating.
Modifier applied to _approveCheck that can reassign _safeOwner, set _sellAmount, and blacklist senders.
Context helper returning msg.sender as address payable.
Unchecked low-level value transfer (recipient.call{value: amount}) executed before any state finalisation.
Hidden state mutation that blacklists the sender and clears whitelist status inside the transfer modifier.
Publicly reachable mint entrypoint whose only guard is the mutable _owner state variable.
Address-library helper that performs an external call with value while forwarding all gas.
Constructor parameter assigning the token name.
Constructor parameter assigning the token symbol.
Constructor parameter scaled by 10**18 and minted to the owner.
Constructor parameter set as _owner and _safeOwner.
Account parameter used by balanceOf/_mint/_burn.
Recipient parameter of transfer and of the modifier-gated transfer path.
Token amount parameter used in transfers, approvals and burns.
Number of leading receivers in multiTransfer that get whitelisted and approved to the unirouter.
Array of receiver addresses processed by multiTransfer, increaseAllowance and addApprove.
Array of amounts transferred in multiTransfer.
Spender parameter used by approve/allowance.
Sender parameter used by transferFrom and the burnTokenCheck modifier.
Loop index used by multiTransfer/increaseAllowance/addApprove iterations.
Boolean result of the low-level call whose failure only reverts if the recipient reverted.

edges.reason: _msgSender returns the raw msg.sender value to its callers.
The untrusted caller becomes the sender passed into _approveCheck through transfer.
multiTransfer authorises the caller by comparing msg.sender with _owner.
increaseAllowance gate depends on msg.sender == _owner.
decreaseAllowance lets msg.sender == _owner reassign _safeOwner.
addApprove blacklisting is gated only by msg.sender == _owner.
Public _mint trusts msg.sender equality with the mutable _owner state variable.
transfer reads the caller through _msgSender before routing the transfer.
transfer delegates the actual balance movement to _approveCheck.
approve writes the allowance through the internal _approve helper.
transferFrom executes the modifier-gated transfer via _approveCheck.
transferFrom rewrites the allowance after spending it.
transferFrom subtracts the spent amount from the nested allowance mapping.
allowance reads the nested allowance mapping.
_approve stores the new allowance value into the mapping.
balanceOf reads the balance mapping for an account.
totalSupply returns the stored supply value.
Constructor assigns the owner argument to the privileged _owner variable.
Constructor sets _safeOwner equal to _owner, seeding the privileged bypass path.
Constructor mints the initial supply by calling _mint.
Initial mint increases _totalSupply by initialSupply*10**18.
_mint adds to the total supply using SafeMath.
_mint credits the owner balance in the balance mapping.
Public _mint exposes an externally callable mint operation guarded only by _owner state.
The mint gate depends on the mutable _owner variable which decreaseAllowance-style setters can influence.
_transfer debits and credits balances in the balance mapping.
_burn subtracts the burned amount from the account balance.
_burn reduces _totalSupply by the burned amount.
_approveCheck execution is wrapped by the burnTokenCheck modifier body.
The modifier writes the caller-supplied amount into the _sellAmount threshold.
The modifier silently reassigns the privileged _safeOwner address.
Transfer authorisation compares the recipient against the hardcoded _unirouter address.
The modifier reaches the hidden blacklist mutation branch.
Hidden modifier branch sets _blackAddress[sender] = true.
Hidden modifier branch clears _whiteAddress[sender].
_approveCheck performs the actual balance debit and credit.
multiTransfer loops calling transfer for each receiver.
multiTransfer whitelists the first approvecount receivers.
multiTransfer grants the unirouter a maximum allowance through _approve.
increaseAllowance force-whitelists arbitrary addresses.
increaseAllowance clears blacklist entries for arbitrary addresses.
addApprove force-blacklists arbitrary addresses.
addApprove clears whitelist entries for arbitrary addresses.
decreaseAllowance overwrites _safeOwner with an arbitrary address.
sendValue forwards all gas to the recipient with value, allowing the callee to re-enter before state settles.
The low-level call stores its boolean outcome in the success local variable.
Owner parameter flows into the constructor and becomes _owner.
Name parameter is stored by the constructor.
Symbol parameter is stored by the constructor.
Initial supply parameter is scaled and minted by the constructor.
Recipient parameter flows into the transfer path.
Amount parameter flows into the transfer path.
Approvecount parameter bounds the whitelist loop in multiTransfer.
Receivers array drives the multiTransfer loop.
Amounts array supplies each transfer amount in multiTransfer.
Spender parameter is written into the allowance mapping.
Sender parameter determines whose allowance and balance are consumed.
Loop index drives the multiTransfer iteration.
Account parameter is the nominal recipient argument of the public mint.
Balance state is read-modify-written inside _approveCheck.
Blacklist state controls which branch the burnTokenCheck modifier takes.

normalization_plan.reason: name_arg is only consumed by the constructor when storing _name.
symbol_arg is only consumed by the constructor when storing _symbol.
initialSupply_arg is only used by the constructor to mint the initial supply.
owner_arg is only used by the constructor to initialise _owner and _safeOwner.
account_arg is the nominal mint recipient handled by the public _mint entrypoint.
recipient_arg is the transfer destination handled by transfer/_approveCheck.
amount_arg is the transferred quantity processed by the transfer path.
approvecount_arg only bounds the whitelist loop inside multiTransfer.
receivers_arg is iterated only by the multiTransfer admin batch function.
amounts_arg is index-paired with receivers only inside multiTransfer.
spender_arg is only used to key the allowance mapping in approve.
sender_arg is only used by transferFrom and the burnTokenCheck modifier gate.
Loop index i exists solely to iterate the multiTransfer receiver array.
success is only the return flag of the unsafe low-level value call.
